server.patch_purpose: Reject FreeRDP server-directed reconnects before a redirected TCP connection.

notice: LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt are preserved from the official WAR distribution. Native server LICENSE/NOTICE and local patch are included in the image. Java/Tomcat and the WAR application are not included. The native engine listens on container loopback under UID 1001; the application owns same-origin WebSocket authorization. SSH is enabled only for explicitly configured targets; RDP session activation remains closed pending its native end-to-end release gate.
reproducibility_limits: Python base image is digest-pinned, upstream source is SHA256-pinned and signature-checked. Debian packages use the distribution security repositories and are not byte-for-byte snapshot-pinned.
